content:
Implemented and committed as `801e4ba` on branch `feature/persist-feature-schema`.

The change persists and applies the raw feature schema, validates duplicate aliases and missing features, returns HTTP 400 for API validation errors, and derives export width from the training description.

Verification: module imports succeeded; the existing tests passed when run from their expected directory (`2 passed`). Targeted checks covered alias handling, multi-target evaluation, clustering, and API validation. Running `pytest` from the repository root failed because the existing tests expect a different working directory.

The repository had no `main` branch or remote; the new branch was created from the available `master` baseline instead.
